hypothesis: Ecommerce sellers operating across multiple sales channels repeatedly perform manual inventory synchronization.

population.description: Ecommerce sellers operating at least 2 active sales channels
inclusion_criteria: Actively selling during the observation period
Uses at least 2 active sales channels
Directly performs or oversees inventory operations

success_rule: At least 3 of 5 eligible sellers must record >= 3 manual inventory synchronization events during the 7-day observation period.
failure_rule: Fail if fewer than 3 of 5 eligible sellers meet the primary threshold or usable sample < 5.
